title: Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.13234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. translated_title: 基于拉格朗日神经网络的史瓦西测地线运动学习
translated_abstract: 拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）通过参数化一个标量拉格朗日量，并利用欧拉-拉格朗日方程推导加速度，从轨迹数据中学习动力学，从而提供了一种变分归纳偏置，相比纯数据驱动模型提升了物理一致性。最近，LNN已被扩展到广义相对论的场景中，而史瓦西测地线仍是一个尚未解决的开放挑战。在复杂相对论系统上进行训练受到以下因素的阻碍：动力学的多样性、数值不稳定性，以及难以充分采样物理上相关且多样化的轨道区域。我们引入了两项协同改进：一是解耦的位置-速度归一化方案，该方案独立地重新缩放每个坐标及其时间导数，并对加速度目标进行重新加权，以平衡所有通道的贡献；二是一种能量约束的对数均匀采样数据集生成策略，该策略基于内（摘要在此处被截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 本文提出解耦的位置-速度归一化方案与能量约束的对数均匀采样数据生成策略两项协同改进，攻克了拉格朗日神经网络学习史瓦西测地线运动这一广义相对论领域的开放性挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two coordinated improvements—a decoupled position-velocity normalization scheme and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy—to tackle the open challenge of training Lagrangian Neural Networks on Schwarzschild geodesic motion.
